results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT composition_formula, prototype_label
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE prototype_label IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
   OR prototype_label ILIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY composition_formula, prototype_label
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT oqmd_entries.composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Ni'
ORDER BY oqmd_entries.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT entry_key, composition_formula, lattice_param_a
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE lattice_param_a < 4
ORDER BY lattice_param_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula, f.gap_ev
FROM oqmd_formation_energies f
JOIN oqmd_entries e ON f.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE f.gap_ev IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT entry_key) AS on_hull_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE on_hull = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula,
       fe.delta_e,
       fe.hull_distance,
       fe.on_hull
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE fe.delta_e < -0.5
ORDER BY fe.on_hull DESC, fe.hull_distance ASC, fe.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT entry_key) AS entry_count
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY entry_count DESC, symbol
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
  oqmd_entries.composition_formula,
  oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e,
  oqmd_formation_energies.hull_distance,
  oqmd_formation_energies.on_hull
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios
  ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.symbol = 'Al'
  AND oqmd_formation_energies.on_hull = TRUE
ORDER BY oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.crystal_system,
  AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e) AS avg_eform
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key
GROUP BY oqmd_entries.crystal_system
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS metastable_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE hull_distance < 0.05
  AND on_hull = false
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT e.composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries e
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios er_ni
    WHERE er_ni.entry_key = e.entry_key
      AND er_ni.symbol = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios er_al
    WHERE er_al.entry_key = e.entry_key
      AND er_al.symbol = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY e.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  e.composition_formula,
  e.prototype_label,
  r.wyckoff_site,
  r.symbol,
  f.delta_e
FROM oqmd_element_ratios r
JOIN oqmd_entries e ON r.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies f ON e.entry_key = f.entry_key
WHERE r.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
  AND r.symbol = 'Co'
ORDER BY f.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.composition_formula,
       e.spacegroup_number,
       fe.gap_ev
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE e.spacegroup_number = 221
  AND fe.gap_ev > 0
ORDER BY fe.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  symbol,
  polymorph_count,
  gs_spacegroup
FROM oqmd_reference_states
ORDER BY polymorph_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  oqmd_element_ratios.symbol,
  AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.hull_distance) AS average_hull_distance
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
JOIN oqmd_entries
  ON oqmd_element_ratios.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
WHERE oqmd_element_ratios.atomic_ratio = 0.75
GROUP BY oqmd_element_ratios.symbol
ORDER BY average_hull_distance ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH compound AS (
    SELECT e.entry_key, e.composition_formula, fe.delta_e
    FROM oqmd_entries e
    JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
    WHERE e.composition_formula = 'Co3Ti'
),
ref_energies AS (
    SELECT c.entry_key,
           SUM(er.atomic_ratio * rs.energy_pa) AS weighted_ref_energy
    FROM compound c
    JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er ON er.entry_key = c.entry_key
    JOIN oqmd_elements el ON el.symbol = er.symbol
    JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs ON rs.symbol = el.symbol
    GROUP BY c.entry_key
)
SELECT c.composition_formula,
       c.delta_e,
       r.weighted_ref_energy,
       c.delta_e - r.weighted_ref_energy AS formation_enthalpy_from_reference
FROM compound c
JOIN ref_energies r ON r.entry_key = c.entry_key
ORDER BY c.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  e.composition_formula,
  e.prototype_label,
  f.delta_e AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  f.hull_distance,
  f.on_hull
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies f
  ON f.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE e.prototype_label IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  AND f.on_hull = true
  AND f.delta_e < -0.3
ORDER BY f.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT r.symbol AS a_site,
       AVG(f.delta_e) AS avg_formation_enthalpy
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios r ON r.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies f ON f.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE e.prototype_label = 'L12'
  AND f.on_hull = TRUE
  AND r.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
GROUP BY r.symbol
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy ASC
LIMIT 10000;
